routes.title: The Exit Code
routes.lane: family function / small talk / social battery / private signal
routes.hook: She didn't say "let's go." Her face did.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Aachu can perform politeness longer than she wants, but asking to leave can feel rude or dramatic.
routes.proof_engine: One more 'aur batao?', one eyebrow SOS, Zuv quietly creates a snack/exit excuse.
routes.zuv_role: He reads the signal and makes leaving easy without making her explain.

routes.title: Tu Bol Na
routes.lane: awkward phone call / public voice / help without shrinking
routes.hook: Some people can do hard things. They just prefer backup voice.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Asking someone else to speak can look childish unless the story frames it as trust.
routes.proof_engine: Aachu starts the call, freezes at the awkward part, slides the phone, Zuv handles one line and gives it back.
routes.zuv_role: He lends voice briefly, then returns agency.
routes.payoff: Love is not taking over. It is standing close enough.

routes.title: The Return Counter Treaty
routes.lane: shop return / awkward public interaction / courage distribution
routes.hook: Every couple has one person who can return the wrong item.
routes.emotional_obstacle: The situation is relatable, but it risks becoming task content instead of love.
routes.proof_engine: Wrong bill, return counter, Aachu's expression, Zuv starts the sentence, she finishes it.
routes.zuv_role: He opens the awkward door but does not make her small.
routes.payoff: Love is a shared courage system.

routes.title: The Temperature Committee
routes.hook: Some couples don't sleep. They negotiate climate.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Broad and drawable, but too close to rejected blanket/domestic object dispute patterns.
routes.proof_engine: AC remote, fan speed, blanket tug, one person cold, one person warm.
routes.zuv_role: He turns compromise into comfort, but risks becoming caretaker again.
routes.payoff: Love is finding one room for two bodies.

routes.title: The Screenshot Before Delete
routes.lane: camera roll / unposted photos / private seeing
routes.hook: He loved the photos she almost deleted.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Romantic, but too close to rejected photo/glow and one-more-photo lanes.
routes.proof_engine: Aachu deletes frame, Zuv saves one candid version, she pretends annoyed.
routes.zuv_role: He sees the unedited version kindly.
routes.payoff: Love liked the frame she was hiding.

routes.title: The Grocery Cart Committee
routes.hook: Some couples enter for bread and leave with a plot.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Funny and visual, but food/grocery surface can swallow the relationship truth.
routes.proof_engine: Bread list, added snacks, both guilty, cart becomes evidence.
routes.payoff: Love is two people blaming the cart.

routes.title: The Outside Face Was Lying
routes.lane: public performance / private read / social fatigue
routes.emotional_obstacle: Strong but slightly more serious and less instantly funny than R1.
routes.proof_engine: Smiling in a crowd, hand tight on cup, shoulder drop, Zuv notices the shift.
routes.zuv_role: He reads the private state behind the public face.

routes.title: One Look, Full Debrief Later
routes.hook: Some stories start after everyone leaves.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Cinematic but could drift into generic quiet-route or car-conversation softness.
routes.proof_engine: Public smile, car door closes, Aachu exhales, Zuv waits for the full debrief.
routes.zuv_role: He gives space and then listens.
routes.payoff: Love saves the real version for the ride home.
